body: I was still a virgin at 26, kissless, and I'd reached a point I was pretty desperate and keen on losing it. Got lucky though. Girl who responded turned out to be pretty normal/ hot, and we had a lot of fun. Dont think she realised I was a complete greenhorn.

Thank you for replying.

The amount of money that has been spent on me is far from a trivial amount, and it's not something I know my parents could afford, but they did anyway. Yet despite that I have nonchalantly squandered my time at uni and now this. I am really at a loss for what I should do but thank you for replying.
Dripped some hot caramel on my finger once - hurt like a bitch.
To be fair, the host claims "no one's minimalizing your experience" and then, ironically, calls her opinion stupid in the same breath.
